texts.title: 课文一：今天天气怎么样
texts.setting: 王一雪给王一飞打电话，问天气。

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.hanzi: 这里的天不太好，下雨了。
lines.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de tiān bú tài hǎo, xià yǔ le.
lines.english: The weather here is not very good. It is raining.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.pinyin: Yǒudiǎnr dà, wǒ juéde hěn lěng.
lines.english: A bit heavy. I feel cold.

texts.title: 课文二：生病了
texts.setting: 王一雪和杨同乐在公司聊天儿。

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 你昨天没来公司，生病了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān méi lái gōngsī, shēngbìng le?
lines.english: You didn't come to the company yesterday. Were you sick?

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 对，我昨天去医院看病了。
lines.pinyin: Duì, wǒ zuótiān qù yīyuàn kànbìng le.
lines.english: Yes. I went to the hospital to see a doctor yesterday.

texts.title: 课文三：看病
texts.setting: 昨天在医院，医生给杨同乐看病。

lines.speaker: 胡医生
lines.english: Let me take a look. How do you feel?

lines.speaker: 胡医生
lines.hanzi: 好的，吃一点儿药，今天休息半天吧。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, chī yìdiǎnr yào, jīntiān xiūxi bàn tiān ba.
lines.english: Okay. Take some medicine and rest for half a day today.

lines.speaker: 胡医生
lines.pinyin: Huí jiā hòu zài hē xiē rè shuǐ.
lines.english: Drink some warm water after you get home.

g_l12_02.title: 语气助词“了”
g_l12_02.english: Sentence-final 了 marks a new situation or change of state.
g_l12_02.russian: 了 в конце предложения показывает изменение.

g_l12_03.title: “太……了”格式
g_l12_03.english: 太...了 expresses a high degree.
